name: Protocol Buffers
designers: Google (Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, Kenton Varda et al.)
summary: Google's language-neutral interface definition language and binary wire format for structured data: .proto files declare messages, enums, oneofs, maps and services, protoc generates code, and field numbers plus tag-length-value encoding give forward/backward-compatible schema evolution. Syntax versions proto2 and proto3 are being superseded by feature-based Editions (2023, 2024).

level_notes.1: No standards-body specification. The language specifications (proto2, proto3 and Edition 2023 grammars), the language guides, the Encoding guide and the ProtoJSON/text-format specs on protobuf.dev are normative in practice; descriptor.proto is the machine-readable schema of schemas. Editions design documents are kept in the protobuf repository.
level_notes.0: protoc (C++, protocolbuffers/protobuf) is the reference compiler; upb is the C kernel behind Python/Ruby/PHP. The repository's conformance/ directory is the official cross-language conformance suite. Independent implementations: protobuf-go, protocompile (Buf), prost (Rust), protobuf.js.
